description: The sections of existing law a 2026 ballot measure amends, creates, repeals or cites (GET /v1/measures/{state}/{number}/statutes). Use for 'which laws does Prop X / Question Y change'. Read from the measure's official text: constitutional amendments cite the constitution (not loaded), and a measure whose text is not yet published returns nothing. Treat the list as a floor. Only states whose code is loaded resolve to section text (see list_statute_coverage); a link to a section we hold carries resolved:true and the text, otherwise just the citation as written.

number.description: Measure number as served by get_ballot_measure, e.g. 'Proposition 319'.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. NJ), DC, GU, or US for the U.S. Code.

name: get_measure_statutes
title: Laws a ballot measure changes
